title: 宗门成长阶段概念原型
user_request: 基于最新设计绘制不同阶段的宗门原型图，随着规模成长，仙府仙境的意境越来越强烈。

rules: 建筑采用预设位置；通过建设逐步展开同一片山域。
开山小院向住居和生产片区发展，再形成各峰的生活修行组团。
古松、山门、灵泉与主体山势保持可识别，区域用途随规模成长逐步调整。
固定斜俯视、统一二维绘画风格，封闭建筑保持完整外观。
5、20、50、100、150 人仅作为概念构图的规模示例。
150人阶段：主峰承担宗门中枢、传承、核心修行与园林；资源生产集中在外围独立生产谷，各峰保有生活修行组团。
150人阶段美术意境为极尽奢华的仙家洞天：以多层仙宫、汉白玉台基、琉璃重檐、金铜雕饰、悬廊与层叠水庭形成鲜明的建筑层次和珍贵材质表现。

stages.title: 清幽小院
stages.concept: 主殿、住居、膳食与田地紧凑相邻，古松、清泉与薄雾形成初始山居意境。
stages.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Chinese xianxia sect-management game environment concept prototype, one complete high-resolution landscape illustration, 16:9.
Art direction: exquisite hand-painted 2D game background, fixed elevated oblique view around 40 degrees, crisp legible architecture and warm human-scale activities, intricate yet restrained brushwork, polished Chinese landscape painting fused with readable game environment design. Physically coherent buildings with closed roofs and walls, plausible human-sized doors and stairs. Warm timber, ivory plaster, desaturated celadon slate roofs, pale weathered stone, rich pine and bamboo. All architecture rooted on continuous natural rocky mountain terraces with walkable stone paths. The scene is designed for a management game; believable housing, food, farming, study, work and outdoor cultivation spaces matter. Prioritize elegant coherent shapes over microdetail clutter.
Geographic identity for the five-stage series: a small founder courtyard in the lower-central mountain saddle; a distinctive old windswept pine just left of its main hall; a small crescent-shaped turquoise spring below-right of the courtyard, draining through a rocky watercourse toward the bottom-left; a modest roofed timber entrance gate south of the founder courtyard; eastward stepped residential terraces (image right); westward fertile production valley (image left); four tall natural ridges in the distance arranged around the central valley. Preserve these landmarks through growth. Later architecture extends into neighboring terraces and peaks while the original courtyard stays recognizable.
Lighting: clear luminous daylight, natural directional shadows, clear walkable ground, layered mountains and atmospheric depth; restrained spiritual radiance and increasing cloud-sea majesty across later stages.
Presentation: landscape painting fills the frame, no panels, text, labels, numbers, diagrams, UI, grid, watermark or logo. This is a concept prototype, not a claimed engine screenshot. No floating islands; terrain, bridges and paths stay physically connected. No roof cutaways, no giant people, no giant empty ceremonial squares.
Input reference: the supplied image is a reference for painterly craft, materials, friendly human scale and architectural detailing; compose a new larger mountain estate scene, not a copy of the close-up.
Stage 1 of 5: a newly founded sect of approximately five residents, quiet and intimate, “清幽小院”. One small main hall, one shared dormitory wing, one tiny kitchen/store annex, two tended medicinal and rice plots, a modest outdoor practice patch, the old pine and clear spring. Five small robed people visibly live and work here: garden tending, carrying a basket, walking, and quiet practice; integrate each naturally at human scale. The founder courtyard and its immediate terrain occupy roughly half the picture so the buildings and people can be appreciated; generous untouched green terraces and distant rugged peaks surround it. Restrained comfortable prosperity; no palace scale yet. Soft mist lingers only deep in distant ravines; most of the foreground is fresh green daylight with clean air. The mood is a hidden mountain retreat with the first trace of spiritual grace. Show how this same terrain can grow into a much larger sect later. One beautifully composed standalone image.

stages.title: 群峰仙境
stages.concept: 恢宏主峰仙宫与四峰琼楼玉宇，共用汉白玉、青蓝琉璃与金铜装饰；玉阶悬廊和层叠仙池融入云海霞光，外围生产谷独立承担资源供给。
stages.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit.
Asset: the ultimate mature-stage environment concept for a Chinese xianxia sect of about 150 elite cultivators. One spectacular full-bleed 16:9 high-resolution hand-painted 2D panorama.
INPUT ROLE: the supplied image is a geographic/zoning reference and edit target. Keep its fixed elevated oblique camera, overall mountain arrangement, four inhabited peaks in the upper half, separate agricultural valley at the far left, and the main foreground mountain. Keep the recognizable ancient pine, original southern gateway location and spring watercourse. You may fully redesign and rebuild the ARCHITECTURE on its established terraces to realize the lavish visual target.
PRIMARY ART DIRECTION: “极尽奢华的仙家洞天，琼楼玉宇，金阙瑶台，真正住在云端的仙府”. Extravagant celestial opulence, the wealth and superb craftsmanship of an immortal realm, breathtaking exquisite architecture above a luminous cloud ocean. The change must be immediately apparent at thumbnail size through a radically richer architectural silhouette, splendid precious materials, grand stepped terraces and ceremonial gardens.
MAIN PEAK: transform the main foreground central mountain into an extraordinary coherent IMMORTAL PALACE COMPLEX, the commanding focal point of the entire picture. A magnificent three-to-five-tier central audience palace rises from three enormous but beautifully proportioned carved WHITE JADE terraces; elegant wings and two graceful side towers form a strong balanced composition with subtle asymmetry from the rocks and old pine. Deep luminous blue-green and turquoise glazed tile roofs, sweeping double/triple eaves, intricate polished gold and warm bronze ridgework, exquisite golden finials, carved dragon/cloud motifs in balustrades, luxurious pale stone columns, delicately ornamented vermilion/timber door panels, jewel-toned silk banners. Make gold details bold enough to read at this view, richly crafted rather than a uniform gold wash. Roof forms and beams have genuine layered dimensional structure. White jade monumental stairways split around mirror pools and meet a broad audience forecourt; halls have normal believable human-scale doors and occupied galleries, conveying a lavish estate for 150 rather than a vast city.
Add covered elevated colonnades, richly detailed bridges between TERRACES, crescent viewing balconies over cliffs and elegant multi-tier scripture/cultivation towers in the main ensemble. All are physically supported by the mountain shelves. The historical pine and founder courtyard are kept as a carefully restored exquisite ancestral garden integrated into the lower ceremonial complex.
CELESTIAL GARDENS: in the main foreground replace rustic landscape surfaces with a breathtaking sequence of jade reflecting pools, lotus terraces, silk-smooth cascades over carved stone, sculptural pines, flowering magnolia/peony groves, elegant scholar rocks, white-jade lanterns and delicate gilded waterside pavilions. Broad clear circulation routes and restful negative space reveal the workmanship. Water has a subtle inner turquoise luminosity and the terraces catch pale gold light.
FOUR PEAK COMMUNITIES: each of the four established upper peaks becomes a distinct luxurious mountain palace community in the same ivory/jade/gold architectural family, with multiple enclosed residential wings, shared dining courts and cultivation terraces arranged behind its signature hall. These buildings are grand and sophisticated, with layered roofs, ornate galleries and elegant landscaped courtyards. One peak has tall slender scripture towers, another a dramatic layered cultivation hall, the others have varied palace silhouettes. Strong hierarchy: the MAIN foreground palace is largest and most splendid. Keep inhabited living functions and small people walking/studying in all precincts.
OUTER PRODUCTION: agriculture and practical resource buildings remain ONLY in the small FAR LEFT outer valley across the forested ravine, subordinate in size and focus. The main peak and four ceremonial/cultivation precincts contain refined gardens, not crop fields or industrial facilities.
ATMOSPHERE: luminous warm dawn breaking above a vast sea of pearl-white clouds, long peach-gold light shafts, soft violet and cyan distant mountain layers, long silver waterfalls dropping into cloud-filled chasms, sparkling prismatic mist over water, glowing cloud edges. A divine sumptuous serene sanctuary with clear architectural detail and extraordinary depth. Clouds occupy ravines and frame palace foundations, leaving terraces and roofs perfectly readable.
STYLE: exquisitely painted Chinese high-fantasy game concept, elegant fine brushwork, crisp high-contrast foreground detail, masterful atmospheric perspective, precious material differentiation (translucent jade sheen, warm gleaming metal, luminous glazed tile, carved pale stone, dark lacquer). Lavish richness balanced by monumental clean shape design; let the image feel truly celestial and costly.
Preserve enclosed complete roofs/walls, coherent scale, terrain, and connected stone bridges. No floating islands, no roof cutaways, no modern objects, no text, captions, map symbols, panels, UI, watermark or logo. One complete image with the palace, gardens and four peaks fully composed, no cropping of the main palace crown.
